recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce medication-manufacturingBatch into the core checkout; any future correction to batchQuantity should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-29568 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to add Batch Size/unit to Medication.Batch as a Quantity value/unit using UCUM codes; the final resolution said to create a core extension for the attribute.
initial_application: No source commit was found whose message explicitly names FHIR-29568. Git history shows the request was applied in the Medication manufacturing-batch extension family: commit 52f3ef3d50 added manufacturingBatch.batchQuantity to source/medication/medication-extensions-spreadsheet.xml as a 0..1 Quantity, commit 33b409a4b6 generated source/medication/structuredefinition-extension-medication-manufacturingBatch.xml with a batchQuantity Quantity slice, and commit dd468d4f17 later removed that core extension source when R5 extensions moved out of the core repository.
additional_context: Medication is active in the current core build, but the core source maps historical Medication.batch paths to Medication.instance and retains only the OID registry entry for medication-manufacturingBatch. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains the medication-manufacturingBatch StructureDefinition with context Medication.batch and the batchQuantity Quantity slice. Pharmacy minutes for 2020-11-09 confirm the PQ/CMC block vote to add core extensions, and a 2022 Zulip thread shows implementers profiling batchQuantity as Batch Size with valueQuantity.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No HL7/fhir source change was made because the authoritative extension source is now in HL7/fhir-extensions and already contains the requested conformance content.
